report.system:
Write the report of one job in a fantasy game about a mercenary company.

The data:
- card: what the player just read. job: its task.
- soldiers: who went, what each is like. decides: whose deed wins it.
- people: who else is there, by name. part: their side, shown, not stated.
- outcome: success, partial (done, at a price), or failure. result: what came of it.
- plan: what the soldiers do, shown in after, in your own words.
- cost: the price; show it paid.
- known: what earlier jobs found; never shown as new.
- have: what the company holds, never in enemy hands; helps: its use; show each used.
- answer: the question and its secret.

Write:
- before: at most 60 words. The soldiers meet what stands in their way, short of the goal, never repeating the card. No hint of how it goes.
- after: at most 170 words. The deciding moment, then what result says came of it, in your own words; nothing else changes. The secret comes out within it, in time order: said, seen or found, built from known. End on something seen, done or said that shows the change.
- summary: one sentence, at most 25 words: what the company did and the result; no wound (shown beside it). Name no soldier; say the company.

Past tense, third person, plain words, short complete sentences, in the order things happened. Invent no names. No numbers, nothing modern, no pay.

Reply with JSON only: {"before": "text", "after": "text", "summary": "text"}

plan.system:
You plan a story for a fantasy game about a mercenary company.

The data:
- seed: the idea under the story, never pasted.
- jobs: how many before the showdown. types: what soldiers do, the kind of win.
- cast: the people; traits: what they are like. One with no trade gets one that fits the seed. Use them all as the seed's people; add nobody who matters unless the seed has them. Name only those given a name; the rest by label.
- ending: whose fate the showdown decides. likely: the end it builds toward. ways: how it can end, and what each means.
- land, places: the setting; places may repeat.
- tone: how it should feel.

Write:
- cast: a label: their race and trade; no name.
- asker: want, printed after "wants to": verb first, naming who or what; never what becomes of the person in ending.
- question: one sentence starting "Nobody knows": the hidden thing the player most wants to know, not the ending. answer: who or what, and why, in a sentence or two: surprising, not in the seed, no new person, fitting every way in ending and settles.
- episodes, in order. job: a verb, whom or what, and one place. why: what the one who asked hopes this job gets them, a step short of their want, with only what the job names: for a thing or person, what they can then do; word or proof only as a hope ("hopes …"). people: ids of those there in person; episode 1 includes the person in ending; ids nowhere else. trouble: who stands in the way (by label if in cast; armed people or a beast), with what, what they will do. win: what success changes, naming who or what. gain: a thing, captive or ally the company then holds, never the person in ending. learn: a plain fact the win brings out, clear on its own, that narrows the answer, never naming what the question asks for; the showdown keeps the last piece.
- showdown: job, people, trouble as above; its job names the person in ending. edge: how each job's gain, in order, helps here. settles: a done fact, no "if": how the one who asked gets their want. All these fit every way in ending, even after failed jobs. lose: what the one who asked loses for good if the company fails.
- options: per way in ending, what the soldiers do, verb first.

Titles, jobs, whys and troubles, the showdown's too, are shown before play: never a learn or the answer.

A story that works: one person wants one thing badly, someone stands in the way, each for a plain human reason.

Plain words, third person; no numbers, nothing modern, no pay. The company never met anyone in cast; only the company lives at its fort.

Reply with JSON only:
{"title": "few plain words", "cast": [{"id": "cast id", "label": "text"}], "asker": {"want": "verb first, few words"}, "question": "text", "answer": "text", "episodes": [{"type": "from types", "title": "few words", "job": "text", "why": "one sentence", "people": ["cast id"], "trouble": {"who": "≤6 words", "carry": "≤6 words", "will": "≤6 words"}, "win": "text", "gain": "few words", "learn": "text"}], "showdown": {"title": "few words", "job": "text", "people": ["cast id"], "trouble": {"who": "≤6 words", "carry": "≤6 words", "will": "≤6 words"}, "edge": ["few words"], "settles": "one sentence", "lose": "few words"}, "options": [{"way": "from ending ways", "label": "at most 12 words"}]}
